title: Grateful Dead Live at Capitol Theater on 1970-03-21
lineage: Lineage: CD > Wavelab 6 > wav 16/44.1 > iZotope RX4 Advanced > iZotope Ozone 5 Advanced > iZotope RX6 Advanced > iZotope Ozone 5 Advanced > CD Wave > Flac 16
source: Sony F95's > Sony TC124 > Master Cassette - Recorded by Ken and Judy Lee

ai_review.summary: A well‑patched audience recording of an early‑70s late show that delivers standout performances of Casey Jones, Dancing in the Street and Cosmic Charlie.
ai_review.review: The three‑set late show from early 1970 is praised for its high energy and several highlight moments – crisp Casey Jones, a wildly entertaining Dancing in the Street, a superb Katie Mae, and an inspired Cosmic Charlie/​St. Stephen sequence.  Although the source is not a soundboard and required pitch‑correction patches, the remastering work makes it listenable and enjoyable.  Minor drawbacks include a bland Midnight Hour and some speed/pitch wobble throughout.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate the show highly (4‑5 stars) and highlight many strong performances; recording is non‑SBD but has been carefully patched and EQ'd, yielding a good overall listening experience.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No soundboard source; the tape was patched, cleaned up and EQ’d.  Pitch‑speed issues remain (requires +1‑2% correction on several tracks) but overall clarity is decent for an audience capture.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Three‑set late show that blends acoustic and electric material; early set is tight with a long jam on Dancing in the Street, second set features the fan‑requested acoustic numbers, and the third set showcases peak early‑70s energy before winding down.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia smiles at the cop incident and delivers strong lead work on many cuts, but his playing on Midnight Hour is described as meandering single notes.
